mapper.select: select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 0 user_type, duc.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name config_group_name, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num, duc.extra_type source_type from dwd_user_conversion duc INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, duc.version, duc.extra_type, dul.config_group_type, dul.name

select duc.dates, duc.pkg, 1 user_type, duc.version, dul.config_group_type, dul.name config_group_name, count(DISTINCT duc.user_id) user_num, duc.extra_type source_type from dwd_user_conversion duc INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = duc.user_id) where duc.dates = #{dates} and duc.dates = duc.register_dates group by duc.dates, duc.pkg, duc.version, duc.extra_type, dul.config_group_type, dul.name
